title: Prime Minister Post-Matric Scholarship for Higher Education 2026
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
short_description: Full financial support and maintenance stipend for undergraduate and postgraduate students from economically disadvantaged families.
detailed_description: Provides complete tuition fee reimbursement plus a monthly maintenance allowance of ₹4,000 for students enrolled in UGC/AICTE accredited degree programs.

title: Karnataka State Vidya Samruddhi STEM Fellowship 2026
short_description: State merit grant for women and rural students pursuing Engineering, Medical, and Pure Science degrees in Karnataka.
detailed_description: Merit-cum-means fellowship designed to encourage STEM enrollments across recognized Karnataka state institutions.
